title: Vector Database for AI Agent Memory: Qdrant vs Chroma vs pgvector
excerpt: A hands-on comparison of Qdrant, Chroma, and pgvector for storing AI agent memory, including the real errors each one throws when you get a filter or a dimension wrong.
focus_keyword: vector database for ai agent memory
seo_title: Vector Database for AI Agent Memory: Qdrant vs Chroma
meta_description: Qdrant, Chroma, and pgvector compared for AI agent memory: real HNSW builds, tenant filtering, and the exact errors each one throws at scale.
social_message:
I rebuilt my agent's memory layer twice in one week because I picked the wrong vector database first.

Qdrant, Chroma, and pgvector all handle AI agent memory differently once you add more than one agent or user. I ran real HNSW builds, tenant filtering, and dimension-mismatch errors on all three, then compared the exact failure modes.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/vector-database-ai-agent-memory/
